world.statement: New Orleans is living ordinary life: work, commerce, tourism, worship, music, heat, transit. Most of the city, most of the time, is normal (the Veil floor of U1/W0)
world.source: v4.1b §3, E03, E08; proposals/concord-2026/ENVELOPE_INTERIM_VALUES_V2_2026-09-19.md ("Veil keeps a floor of U1/W0")

world.statement: Veil-era conditions: effects are subtle and low-amplitude; technology is mostly stable; a few people notice faint wrongness, and no one shares a word for it
world.source: Mech §7.1; rules/trilogy_context_T1_veil.json (tech_state: mostly_stable); v4.1b E01, E04

world.statement: No public event has yet happened. No shared vocabulary, no pattern, no suspicion of anything beyond New Orleans
world.source: v4.1b E15 ("first undeniable civic-scale event"), §9 handoff ("global extent suspected at most" by the end)

world.statement: No MissingThread exists in B01. No anonymous public voice

Institutions are present as footprint and procedure: the Dominion sphere (authority, classification, protection; Lucien's civic/cultural structural-systems bureau works within it) and Technarc (measurement: sensors, protocols, access), both ambient
Informal care networks (future Filaments) already exist as ordinary civic and community infrastructure, not an organisation
The Velvet Vein is a working nightlife room, not anomaly headquarters

Places in play, by route family: a Honey Island-adjacent south-Louisiana wetland community; Tremé/community routes; St. Charles/Garden District/Uptown; the French Quarter and Jackson Square; Marigny/Bywater and the Vein; CBD/civic infrastructure; the riverfront; City Park. District-level specificity unless a venue is recovered and useful

key_character_states.state: Lives and works in New Orleans in a care role that takes her to a family in a medical/care crisis (exact role OPEN). Already perceives subtle wrongness, with no word for it and little confidence in it. Belief: "If I care enough, I should be able to save/fix this." Has a friend (Caro) and a life before the mystery

Already in New Orleans on the Dominion's assignment (B1), under a Dominion-supplied cover he knows is one: the Hollen Institute for Civic Continuity (Vienna), running the Regional Review of Unexpected Public Costs for the parishes around the city, which puts him on the coroner's contract list. Structural timber is his expertise; Sal's crew is how he learns the city's building stock. Credentials, a mandate, an expected report. Sent from Vienna before B01 (ruled); first on the page at E04. The Dominion is not named in B01 (first named at B02 E08); his point of view may think about the cover, more as he grows closer to Seraphine. No explicit distrust of Virelli. Belief: "If I can structure it, I can contain uncertainty." (Amended 2026-10-01 by Q-HR5a–d, Q-HR6, Q-HR6a, Q-HR7; decisions/B01_REDRAFT_HUMAN_READ_ANSWERS_Q_HR_AUTHOR_ANSWERS_2026-09-30.md. Replaces A4's legitimate-bureau reading and the earlier OPEN.)
key_character_states.source: v4.1b R32, E04, §4, v4.1b Explicit non-decisions; MCL follow-up 1

key_character_states.state: Outside the crisis and outside New Orleans (where is OPEN). Lucien's close friend and former/adjacent colleague, with witness, documentation, archive and institutional-literacy skills; current employer OPEN. Arrives by personal choice in Act II
In New Orleans, Seraphine's friend before page one; independently employed in response/care work (employer, credential and hospital OPEN, O2). Does not leave New Orleans in B01 (ruled)
Not in New Orleans. An independent environmental/geospatial crisis researcher whose own data has flagged a Louisiana anomaly. Her E23–E30 is one research visit; she comes back to stay in B02 (E05)
key_character_states.source: v4.1b R34, E23; MCL follow-up 2; VAA §3 T8

key_character_states.state: Runs a neighbourhood food pantry in the Knights' hall and keeps her own book of who needs what; not Seraphine's employer. Renamed from Mara 2026-09-30 (Q-HR4, Q-HR7). Seraphine works at the Beaulieu Center for Family Services, supervised by Denise

Tahl: exists, itinerant, not named before the B03 epilogue; no Tahl trace in B01. Lacuna: a human working musician; a cameo at E31 only, zero portent. Rex: in Detroit; not on the page in B01. Kade: not in B01

statements.statement: The Veil is a hard cap, held by a single soul (Mira's) and tended from outside by Silence and Hope. Blocked pressure is stored and concentrates at thin points
Silence and Hope perceive strain and cannot simply intervene
The swamp near Honey Island is the original Tear, the cap's first break. It is unexplained and unnamed in Veil; nobody in Veil knows it is the Mending site
Pressure surfaces in New Orleans only at precursor level (flickers, ghostwaves), and Jackson Square recurs as a thin point
A faint southwest lean exists in the disturbances. It is perceptible to Lucien only, unnamed

locations_in_play._derivation: DERIVED 2026-09-20 under Ruling 8: assignments are populated and marked PROVISIONAL IN THE FIELD rather than left empty. The place roster and every place-to-type assignment live in grids/locations_registry.csv, which carries the two-layer structure of Ruling 1 - the geography system supplies TYPES, city bibles supply NAMES that map onto a type. Contested ground (Tremé, Marigny, French Quarter, Bywater, Red Lantern Faultline) is assigned there, not omitted. `match` distinguishes an exact place-name hit from an alias inference such as "the swamp" -> Honey Island Swamp. Ledger section 61.
locations_in_play._gap: PER-BOOK ROSTER IS NOT DERIVABLE AND IS NOT INVENTED HERE. No source maps places to books. The milestone grid names a location in only 3 of 9 books, so the entries below are the places this book's own milestones NAME - a floor, never a complete roster, and an empty list means no milestone in this book names a place, NOT that the book has no locations. Ruling 8 authorises deriving the TYPE layer, which is done; it does not supply a book dimension that no source contains. Listing the full 31-place roster under every book would assert that every place appears in every book, which is false. OPEN: a per-book location pass needs a source that does not yet exist. See CLAUDE.md section 4.
